Package library

Class Book

java.lang.Object
library.Book
public class Book extends Object
Represents one book in the library. A book has an ID, a title, an author, a category and a status (Available, Issued or Reserved). A book that is Issued or Reserved also records the borrower (name and ID), and an Issued book has a due date. An issued book that is not returned in time has a fine.
Author:
Narmeen Fatima, Faique Mustafa, Usaid Rauf

  • Constructor Details

    • Book

      public Book(String id, String title, String author, String category)
      Creates a new book. A new book is always Available and has no borrower.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique ID of the book
      title - the title of the book
      author - the author of the book
      category - the category of the book

    • Book

      public Book(String id, String title, String author, String category, BookStatus status, String borrower, String borrowerId, LocalDate dueDate)
      Creates a book with a specific status and borrower details (used when books are loaded from the saved file).
      Parameters:
      id - the unique ID of the book
      title - the title of the book
      author - the author of the book
      category - the category of the book
      status - the status of the book
      borrower - the name of the borrower (empty if none)
      borrowerId - the ID (registration number) of the borrower (empty if none)
      dueDate - the due date of an issued book (null if none)
